  Description: "Umbar is a ruthless city where treachery and corruption run rife within its shadowed streets. None that reside there better represent this than the Corsairs who man Umbar's fleets. The captains of these ships are tyrannical and greedy Men, who will sail the coasts of Gondor and even further with the intent of pillaging the settlements upon the shores.\n\nThe crew under these captains' command will often share their lust for plunder, and need little convincing to set off upon the black-sailed ships in search of new settlements to raze to the ground. Once this band of malicious Men has raided a town, stealing whatever they can lay their hands on, they will splinter into smaller bands, each eager to unleash their own devious brand of destruction and murder upon the villages along the coast. The more fear these bands of Evil Men can instill in their enemies, the higher they will rise up the treacherous ranks of the Corsair fleets."
